name: Backspace Backspace Backspace
source:
In an AI-powered age where original authors have become largely redundant, play as a dejected writer on the brink of losing their creative drive forever.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3058940/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在人工智能驱动的时代，原创作者在很大程度上变得多余，扮演一个濒临永远失去创作动力的沮丧作家。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3058940/]Steam[/url]]
